DURETE DU RESEAU D'EAU POTABLE DES SERVICES INDUSTRIELS DE GENEVE Cette couche vous renseigne sur la dureté de l'eau potable distribuée par les Services Industriels de Genève. La dureté de l'eau est l'expression de sa teneur en calcium et en magnésium. Elle varie en fonction des sols qu'elle traverse. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Services industriels Genève SIG. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
